_readme: Alumni on /alumni/, imported from the old site's Our Alumni page (source: old-site). Fields: id, name, graduation_year (the old page's alumni year heading), majors (only as stated in the bio), minors, current_role/current_org/industry (only where the bio states what the person did after graduating; null otherwise), summary (first sentence of the bio), bio (paragraphs, as written; typos cleaned), photo (written by npm run assets from face detection: source, face box and focal point in % of the original; add focal_override {x, y} in % to move the face centre by hand; see README → Headshot framing), linkedin (only when the page linked that person's own profile), consent_to_publish, consent_basis, source.

alumni.name: Harrisen Cefalu-Schwartz
alumni.summary: Harrisen Cefalu-Schwartz was a vice-chair on the board of trustees and a principal consultant for Snider Consulting Group.
bio: Harrisen Cefalu-Schwartz was a vice-chair on the board of trustees and a principal consultant for Snider Consulting Group. He joined in the Fall of 2022 as a member of Cohort 5.
Harrisen majored in Finance and Operations Management & Business Analytics.

Harrisen has internship experience with Ernst & Young, where he worked as an FSO consulting intern, and at the Executive Office of the President, serving as an intern in the Office of Management and Budget (OMB). These experiences have provided him with a strong foundation in consulting and financial management.

Harrisen served as the Consulting Careers intern for the Office of Career Services, where he focused on helping students build the skills necessary to pursue careers in consulting. He also worked to increase awareness of available opportunities in the field. Previously, Harrisen played a key role in organizing the Smith in the City trip to New York City as the Consulting Track Lead, coordinating networking events and informational sessions to introduce students to career opportunities.
Outside of his academic and professional pursuits, Harrisen enjoys hiking, reading, and spending time with friends and family.
alumni.consent_basis: Listed on the public old site
